lesson: Round 1: the dominant lever is ALLOCATION to the data-starved inclusion class (30/10/10 gave mAP50 0.598, inclusion AP50 0.357, +0.078 over control); small-scale (0.3-0.7) and curated-source candidates were ~neutral vs control (within ~0.03 noise), so size-matching and source-curation are NOT confirmed levers yet. Note patches dropped to 0.708 when starved to 10 imgs, so don't over-starve it. Next: keep inclusion-heavy but give patches a floor, and test whether pushing inclusion higher or stacking small-scale on top of the skew adds anything for inclusion.
